chapter.verse: Apollos in Korin khua-ah a om lai takin Paul in saklam gam a paisuak khit ciangin, Efesa khua-ah tungin nungzuite tawm a mu hi.
“Note in na up khit uh ciangin Kha Siangtho na ngah uh hiam?” ci-in a dot leh, “Kha Siangtho om hi cih thu kote in zak zong ka za kei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Paul in, “Tua bang ahih leh, kua min tawh na kibaptaiz uh hiam?” ci-a a dot ciangin, “Johan’ baptaizna ka ngah uh hi,” a ci uh hi.
Paul in, “Johan in, ‘Kei nungah hong paipa na um ding uh hi,’ ci-in mite kiangah genin, mawhna a kisikkik manunah a baptaiz hi. Tua bang a cihna in Zeisu ahi hi,” ci-in Paul in a gen hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin Topa Zeisu’ min sungah a kibaptaiz uh hi.
Paul in amaute tungah a khut a ngak khit ciangin, Kha Siangtho in amaute tungah hong tung a, amaute in kamtuam pau thei-in thu a hilh uh hi.
Tua mite a kisim ciangin pasal sawm-le-nih pha hi.
Paul in kikhopna innah lutin kha thum tawntung Pasian’ Gam thu gen a, zolin, lau loin a hilh hi.

Mi kimkhat in lungkhauh a, um loin a om uh a, Lampi thu mite mai-ah a kosia uh ahih ciangin Paul in amaute kiang pan paikhia a, nungzuite atuamin a khen khit ciangin Tirannas laihilhna sanginn ah ni simin thu a kikum uh hi.
Tua mah bangin kum nih tawntung hilh ahih ciangin Asia gam sungah a om Judah mi leh Grik mi khempeuhte in Topa’ thu a za za uh hi.
Pasian in Paul’ khut tungah nalamdang liante lak a,
Paul’ pumpi tung pan mainulna puan ahi zongin, kawnggak ahi zongin, khatpeuh peuh cinate kiangah a puak uh ciangin cinatna dam a, dawi gilote a paikhia uh hi.
Ahih hangin a vak kawikawi aisan Judah mi kimkhatte in dawigilo a lut mite tungah Topa Zeisu’ min tawh thupia-in, “Paul in a hilh Zeisu’ min tawh kong sawl hi,” a ci uh hi.
Skeva kici Judah siampi khat’ tapa sagihte in tua bangin ahih uh hi.
Dawi gilote in, “Zeisu ka thei hi, Paul zong ka thei hi. Note in kua mi na hi uh hiam?” a cih khit ciangin,
dawigilo lutpa in tuate tungah diangin amah in zo zaw a, amaute in puan nei loin, liamin, inn pan a taikhia uh hi.
Tua thu Efesa khua-ah a om Judah mite leh Grik mite khempeuh in a zak ciangin a lau uh a, Topa Zeisu’ min a phat uh hi.
A um mi tampite in hong pai uh a, pulakin a gamtatna thu a gen uh hi.
A tawm hi lo aisan theite in zong amau laibute hong paipih uh a, mi mai-ah mei-in a hal uh hi. Hih laibute’ man a kiseh ciangin ngun thennga man ahih a kithei hi.
Tua bangin Topa’ thu in vangliatna tawh khang a, a gualzo hi.

Tua nung ciangin Paul in Makedonia gam leh Akhaia gamah a pai khit ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah pai ding a lungsim sungah hanciamin, “Tua khua ka tun’ khit ciangin Rom khua ka phak teitei kul ding hi,” a ci hi.
Ama nasem mi nih, Timoti leh Erastas Makedonia gamah a paisak khit ciangin amah in Asia gamah tawlkhat khawl lai hi.
Tua lai takin Lampi thu hangin thusia a piang hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Demetrias min nei sum sungpa khat in Diana dawi-numei ngun biakna inn neute bawlin, sumsungte a meetsak thei hi.
Tua pa in sumsungte leh tua bang nasemte a kikhopsak khit ciangin, “Lawmte aw, hih bang nasepna tawh eite in sum i ngah cih na thei uh hi.
Hih Paul in, ‘Mi’ khut tawh kibawl Pasian om lo hi,’ ci-in Efesa khua bek hi lo, Asia gam khempeuh ah mi tampi zol a, a uuksak cih na mu uh, na thei uh hi.

Eite nasepna hong siagawp ding tham loin, a lian dawi-numei Diana biakna inn nasim lo a, Asia gam akipan mi khempeuhte in a biak uh a minthan’na zong a kisiat ding lunghihmawh huai hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin hehna tawh a dim uh a, “Efesa khua Diana a lian hi!” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Khua sung khempeuh gamlumna tawh kidim hi. Amaute in Makedonia pana Paul’ khualzinpihte, Gaias leh Aristarkhus a mat khit uh ciangin, pawikhamna inn sungah lungsim kikhatin a tai uh hi.
Paul in kikhopna sungah lut ding a kisak ciangin nungzuite in a kham uh hi.
Ama lawmte Asia gamneute a uk ulian kimkhatte in zong pawikhamna inn sungah pai lo dingin, mi sawlin Paul kiangah a thuum uh hi.
A kikhawm mite zong gamlumin om uh ahih ciangin, a thu atuam atuam a kiko uh hi. Mi tamzawte in amaute in bang hangin kikhawm ahi uh hiam cih zong a thei kei uh hi.
Judah mite in Alekzander sawlin, mihonpi lak pan a sam uh a, mite mai-ah a paisak uh hi. Alekzander in a khut zanin kham a, mite mai-ah mawh kiphelna thu a gen nop hangin,
Judah mi ahih lam amaute in a theih uh ciangin, “Efesa khua Diana a lian hi!” ci-in nai nih sung dektak aw kikhatin a kiko uh hi.
Khua lai-atpa in mihonpi a daihsak khit ciangin, “Efesa khuapihte aw, Efesa khua in van pan a kiasuk milian Diana biakna inn a kem khuapi hi cih a thei lo kua om ahi hiam?
Hih thute kinial thei lo ahih ciangin note in daitakin na om ding uh kilawm hi. Ngaihsun khol loin bangmah mawk hih kei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, biakna inn hong sut lo, eite pasiannu a kosia lo hih mite nong paipih zenzen uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Demetrias akipan amah tawh a omkhawmte in mi khatpeuh mah tungah thu nei ahih uh leh, zum inn om a, thukhen mangte zong om uh a, amaute in khat leh khat kimawhsak ta uh hen.
Ahih hangin thu dang na koh nop uh leh, a ngeina om bangin mi kikhopna sungah thu kikhen ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tuni-a gamlumna hangin mawhsakna i thuak khak ding lunghihmawhhuai hi. Hih kikhopna-ah thu i gen ding bangmah om lo hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen khit ciangin mi kikhawmte a paikhia sak hi.
